summary: MARKMASTER AS (org. no. 979 555 458) is a private limited company (AS) based in Haugesund, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-01-29. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 18.120 (Trykking ellers). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 8.1 m and net income was NOK 140 249. CEO: Simon Joakim Olsen; board chair: Per Inggard Olsen; auditor: HAUGALAND REVISJON AS.
